input.summary: Insert transition assistance and Sparkling data return/deletion obligations on termination in Section 17
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 17 only requires Sparkling to return Garman's Software and Codes on termination; nothing obliges Garman to help us wind down or to give back our own data. We have added a new Section 17(d) providing up to six months of transition assistance at Garman's then-current rates, return of Sparkling's data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day data export.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (i) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) calendar days of Sparkling's request, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in Garman's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.
